newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Transocean buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Transocean buy reiterated.

text.p: Rodman & Renshaw analyst Iain Smith has reiterated his buy recommendation on drilling company Transocean Offshore Inc.

Transocean yesterday received a two-year contract for its Transocean Explorer semisubmersible rig to work for Petro-Canada for two years, with three-one year options, at a day rate of $105,000. Smith, in a research note, described the deal as "exceptional."

Petro-Canada will also pay a $11 million fee to cover mobilzation costs to eastern Canada and upgrades to the rig, which means it will take only minor modifications to convert Explorer into a premium deepwater semisubmersible, Smith said.

"More importantly, this contract is yet another example of the continued positive momentum regarding contract fixtures and global rig demand as well as Transocean's strong management capabilities," Smith said in the note.
He forecast 1997 earnings per share of $3.60 for Transocean and has a 12- to 18-month price target of $85-$90 for the stock, which was up 1-1/2 at 67-3/4.
